beats.role_note: EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY LAW — misconception: LLMs speed up by computing faster → by reusing work.
beats.narration_text: Here's the idea. Each new word a model writes looks back at every word before it. Instead of redoing that work each time, it saves the results, and reuses them.

props.artifactHeading: How KV Caching Speeds Up LLMs
artifactLines: Without a cache, every new token recomputes attention over all earlier tokens.
Each token's key and value never change, so they are computed once and stored.
Reading the prompt fills the cache; that is the pause before the first word.
After that, each new token adds one query and reads the rest from the cache.
Per new token, the work drops from quadratic to roughly linear in length.
The cost is memory, and it grows with every token in the context.
